title: School sports day
instructions: Spor öğretmeni okul spor gününü anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; saatleri, yerleri ve kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Hello, everyone. Our school sports day is next Wednesday.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: It isn't at school this year. It's at the city sports centre, because our field is too small.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: We are going there by bus. The buses leave at half past eight.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: In the morning, there are running races. In the afternoon, there is football and basketball.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Please wear your school sports clothes: a white T-shirt and blue shorts.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Bring a water bottle and a hat. It is going to be hot and sunny.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Parents can come and watch. It is free for them.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: We are coming back to school at four o'clock.

questions.prompt: Where is the sports day this year?
questions.feedback: Bu yıl şehir spor merkezinde; okulun sahası çok küçük.
questions.evidence: It's at the city sports centre

questions.prompt: What time do the buses leave?
questions.evidence: The buses leave at half past eight.

questions.feedback: Sabah koşu yarışları; öğleden sonra futbol ve basketbol.
questions.evidence: In the morning, there are running races.
a white T-shirt and blue shorts.
